# IC Build

The [package overview](../../crates/ic-build/README.md) owns the current supported
surface and examples. The [artifact guide](artifacts.md) owns Cargo execution,
input inventories, invocation-owned captures and migration contracts. Persistent
Wasm and generic transaction caching are retired.

See [ownership](design/build-ownership.md), the [historical changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
and [workspace provenance](../design/tooling-consolidation.md).
The root workspace owns development and publication commands.
